release_notes:
Fix stale docs: step count, PHP 7.4 leftovers, missing unzip, DNS check caveat

vps-installation.md said "9 setup steps" / "Step 4/9" — install.sh has run
11 steps since the fail2ban and cron-logging steps were added. Also fixed
the PHP config path example (still said /etc/php/7.4, app has used 8.3 for
a while).

vps-installation-manual.md's PHP-8.3 install block was followed by bolt.so
and short_open_tag commands still targeting /etc/php/7.4 — copy-pasting the
manual steps as written would configure the wrong PHP version entirely.

Added two gaps found while installing for a real customer today: a fresh
Ubuntu 24.04 image doesn't always have `unzip` preinstalled, and the
installer's own "Site is responding" check follows public DNS — it can
report success while actually hitting a parking page if DNS isn't pointed
at the server yet, masking a real failure underneath. Documented a
--resolve-based check that verifies the app directly instead.
